source.locator: ### 3. Budget, map, and confirm, subsection (b) re-run keep

proposals.trigger: Re-run /setup-pstack after prior role edits by family, list, or alias.
preconditions: An existing rule with at least one non-default role value.
proposals.expectedObservation: Roles previously changed by family, list, or alias remain those values while the new budget effort mapping is applied to real slugs.

evidenceMapping.note: Success-path re-run preserves inherit-parent roster while changing only the budget line (+1 -1). Guide line 27 restates the same keep-on-rerun rule.

preconditions: Detected set includes a Grok family slug.

evidenceMapping.note: Canonical pairs used inherit-parent for all roles, so the Grok cap branch was not exercised in paired evidence.

source.locator: ### 3. Budget, map, and confirm, subsection (c) panel list length

proposals.trigger: Configure a panel role value as a comma-separated list.
preconditions: Role is arena runners, architect runners, interrogate reviewers, or arena cross-judge pool.
proposals.expectedObservation: Panel role values are lists. One subagent runs per entry, including alias entries, so list length sets fan-out count. arena cross-judge pool remains a list from which Arena selects one differing-family value when possible.

evidenceMapping.note: Paired setup journeys used inherit-parent single values, not multi-entry panel lists.
